resources.string:
Dukto2 shares files and text directly between your devices. After you agree, it starts local network discovery and stores your device identity, settings and transfer history on this device.

Scanning is optional: opening the scanner requests camera access, and its camera component may use the accelerometer to adjust image orientation. Google ML Kit processes barcodes on this device and may send SDK diagnostic and usage data as described in the privacy policy. Camera images are not uploaded by Dukto2.

Notifications and background reception are optional. You can manage permissions in system settings. Please read the privacy policy before choosing whether to agree.
